title: Make all backend marker clear immediate
summary: Make the Reports Clear All Backend Markers button submit the backend-owned all_markers clear command immediately, without requiring a matching Preview All Backend Markers dry run first.
reason: The operator expects one click on Clear All Backend Markers to clear active backend marker blockers without a separate preview step or browser confirmation prompt.
behavior_before: Clear All Backend Markers was blocked unless Preview All Backend Markers had been run in the same page session against a matching marker source/count, and clear actions used a browser confirmation prompt.
behavior_after: Clear All Backend Markers posts /api/failures/clear with scope all_markers and confirm_clear true immediately, lets the backend enumerate marker paths, and updates the local marker table while selected/visible clears keep their existing confirmation behavior.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated packets MP-CHANGE-2026-0619-002/005 using invalid types and unrelated uncovered dirty files: apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/settings/backendResult.js, src/mediapipeline/contracts/config_defaults.py, src/mediapipeline/core/rename/contracts.py, src/mediapipeline/core/rename/planner.py, src/mediapipeline/core/rename/service.py
rollback_plan: Restore the all-marker preview gate and browser confirmation branch in reportsView.js, restore the Reports cleanup copy, and revert the matching static/browser smoke expectations.
notes: No backend route, media policy, source file, output file, pending publish, or marker archive service behavior changed; the UI still calls the backend-owned failure marker clear command.
